//: The documented tier's config.json with the listener caps raised by the lab's rule (keys named // are comments; the server ignores unknown keys).

websdr.//: public_port added: when it is missing, the server rewrites config.json at startup to add it (config.rs migrate_global_config_json), and this directory is mounted read-only.
websdr.name: NovaSDR

limits.//: audio, waterfall, events: 2000 (were 100, 200, 200). ws_per_ip counts sockets per TCP peer address (a listener uses up to four) and has no off value; 100000 turns it off in effect (was 50).

updates.//: added: the default (true) asks api.github.com for a newer release at startup.
